title: Some Slaanesh and Tzeentch Unit for Miao Ying
author: sbun2012
description:
Miao Ying's corruption mod (Lazy's Corrupted Miao Ying Progression (CORRUPTION CORE + STAGES + RESKINS <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/23878-lazys-corrupted-miao-ying-progression-corruption-core-stages-reskins/>) is great and I love the idea so I just added some Slaanesh and Tzeentch unit for Miao Ying to go with the playthought.

I can't figure out how to make it work with the progression system so you just have to at the start...I guess just don't build those unit until you feel you progressed deep enough.

Also added unit upgrades in the tech tree, they are rather more powerful than the baseline upgrades since your demon unit can't get lord skill tree or harmony to help them.

Reaching the dragon emperor's blessing will grant all your unit, daemonic or good old cathy unit 69 barrier!

Added unit are as follow, (Units are only available for Miao Ying's faction.)

Sla marauders (normal, whip and spear and the 2 DLC version but they are kinda just worse than devoted version)

Sla Hellstriders (normal and hellscourge)

Sla Seekers (normal and heartseeker)

Sla Chosen (only whip version, for some reason I can't find the normal version in the table)

Sla Keeper of Secrets

Sla Fiends

Sla Demonettes (normal and exalted)

Tze Chosen (helbert only, again can't find the normal on the table...)

Tze Horrors (blue,pink and exalted pink)

Tze Chao knights (normal and lance)

Tze spawn

Tze screamer

Tze burning chariot

Tze Flamer (normal and exalted)

Tze warp chicken

Tze soul grinder

This mod is prob not very balanced...is more for role playing when play the corrupted Miao Ying

Highly recommend the Warrior of Slaanesh reskin <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/24568-warrior-of-slaanesh-reskin/> by dbswlgn3786 <https://www.loverslab.com/profile/2090808-dbswlgn3786/>
